notes: Access route: direct fetch worked throughout (no WAF/anti-bot encountered). Confirmed Shopify store via /sitemap.xml (sitemap_products_1/2.xml, sitemap_collections_1.xml). Full nav dump (317 links) enumerated via probe.py nav on homepage. Category/qty verified per Rule 1 by fetching each collection's /collections/<handle>/products.json and counting unique product ids (not the unreliable products_count field); every included collection returned in a single unpaginated page (<=250 items) so the enumerated count is exact and exhaustive. No rendered 'N items' header exists on this SPA-style storefront (collection pages show no static count text), so products.json enumeration is the best available evidence, consistent with project Rule 1/2. Excluded as out-of-scope: Furniture (console/coffee/side/nest tables, benches/pouffes, trolley/butler trays), Bed Linen/Cushions/Bedspreads and their named pattern lines (Briza, Quorra, Matrix, Tzarina, Ziana, Kai, Qarshi, Art, Songbird) -- all textiles; Cutlery, Napkins & Napkin Rings, Table Runners & Placemats -- cutlery/textiles; Flowers, Potted Plants + Greens -- explicitly artificial/faux per site's own SEO copy ('luxury artificial flowers', 'luxury faux plants'); Gifting for him/her, Housewarming/Trousseau/Wedding Gifting -- gift-guide roll-ups; New Arrivals -- never-extract list. Mixed roll-ups inspected by title and dropped (Rule: drop, don't pad): 'Candles & Scents' (28/30 sampled titles are reed diffusers, incense, and scented jar candles = Home Fragrance; only 2 plain pillar candles, not enough to justify a decorative-candle row) -- Candle Holders/Hurricanes/Lanterns/Votives/Candelabra were kept as their own clean collections; 'Bath Accessories' (of 30 sampled: 14 are La Florentina soap/lotion/shower gel = personal care, 8 are bath mat/towel sets = textiles, only ~7-8 cotton jars/tumblers/a bath tray are arguably decorative) -- dominant character is personal-care+textile so the whole collection was dropped rather than padded; 'Bar Accessories' (bar cabinet = furniture, wine chillers = bar tool) -- dropped entirely; 'Dustbins' -- functional waste bins, not decorative accessories, dropped; 'Games' (chess sets) -- dropped, not a core decor product type. Also dropped as brand/pattern-line or 'View All' roll-up pages that duplicate products already counted inside the specific leaf collections above (would double-count): Le' Floret, Santorini, Fleur-De-Lis, Medicci, Alessi, Le Jardin, Cammille (dinnerware/glassware pattern lines -- verified 'medicci' handle returns the same items already inside Dinnerware/Dinner Sets/Platters & Cake Stands); Jardin, Brillo, Orbis, Aurum, Linea, Lumina, Lexus, Lattice, Alpha, Zensar, Pixel, Horn, Crystal, Marble, Antique, Earthy, Glass (leather/material lines -- verified 'leather' and 'horn' handles return items already inside Tissue Boxes/Dustbins/Desk Accessories/Serving Trays/Coasters/Candle Holders/Statues & Sculptures); and the aggregator 'View All' collections (lighting, wall-decor, home-decor, office-den-decor, serving, dining, bar-glassware, candleware-lighting, furniture, leather). Floor Lamps: products.json returns 3 items but one ('Le Feu Eye Mocca Black & Gold Fireplace') is a fireplace, not a lighting fixture -- manually excluded by product type per project convention (product type beats collection placement), leaving 2 genuine floor lamps; documented in that row's evidence/flag. Rule 0 gains: none of the categories were excluded for having a 'room' word in the name -- Wall Mirrors/Wall Clocks/Wall Art were judged and kept purely on product type. Duplicate-company determination: Address Home (addresshome.com) is a single-brand Delhi-headquartered luxury home decor/gifting retailer with its own physical stores across India (Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata, Chandigarh, Hyderabad, Pune, Ahmedabad, Nagpur, Ludhiana, Surat, Mysore, Raipur, Coimbatore, Chennai per its store-locator nav pages); its domain, product catalog and SKU prefixes (AH#####) are unique to this brand and do not match any other company processed in this project -- no duplicate found.
